contract.num_circuits: Exactly ceil(75/J); J is inferred from consecutive word_0..word_(J-1) registers.
contract.public_registers: Identical quantum IDs and order in every family member; selection exactly 11 qubits; words disjoint and equal width.
contract.output_order: Batch k is flattened as columns k*J..k*J+J-1. There is no column-index indirection or per-file batch-size metadata.
contract.partial_padding: All final padding words must be zero for every valid address. The same J registers remain declared and charged; the transition into padding still clears the previous slot word.
contract.file_order: Directory filenames must be contiguous angle_k_0..angle_k_(K-1), with a consistent format in auto mode. An ordered list of arbitrary paths/objects is also accepted by the Python API, but still has exactly K members and positional batch semantics.
contract.scratch_boundary: Every circuit ends with zero quantum workspace, preserved selection and no phase. reset_between_circuits clears simulator state and restores only selection and words, so classical and quantum prefix scratch cannot persist between files.
contract.workspace_cost: Q_total=84+8J+max(303, angle_Q-11-8J). angle_Q<=128, so Q_total=387+8J for J=1..8. The 303 shared-workspace floor is not permission to exceed the 128-qubit circuit cap.
contract.toffoli_cost: A = half of actual mean Toffoli-like execution over forward and reverse passes. T_total=6662+2A. CCX,CCZ,CSWAP count; classical-conditioned gates count only when executed. Static CCX sums equal A only for unconditional fixed-count families.
contract.other_gate_cost: X/CX/CZ and classical logic are not charged as Toffoli-like gates; HMR/R are available with exact phase correction and cleanup. Z_POW is explicitly banned. Reaction depth and total instruction count are reported but do not multiply this task cost.
contract.documented_oracle: Module contract says arbitrary-target XOR oracle. The executable verifier checks forward/reverse reachable batches. A reachable word-tag identity alone is not proof of the arbitrary-target extension.
contract.regrouping: Noncontiguous old columns require reordering/re-encoding the angle table and tree edges; API file order does not introduce a gather map. Parent-before-child is necessary but not sufficient for preserving vectors. Swapping disjoint Givens rotations is exact; rotations sharing a vertex generally do not commute.
contract.extra_identity_files: Extra files are forbidden by exact circuit count. An identity circuit in a legitimate slot implies identical successive batches and is valid only if those decoded angles and physics remain correct.

identity_controls.scope: All 1220 valid addresses, all 75 actual recovered angle columns, not the declared NPZ angle_words.
identity_controls.tag_relation: bit6 XOR bit7 = address_bit[a] AND address_bit[b], with pair selected by column modulo 5.
identity_controls.free_use: One CX exposes each existing word tag without Toffoli on the reachable input batch. J=4 rotates which four tags are present every batch; k=0 starts at zero and has no incoming tags.
identity_controls.synthesis_caution: Tag transitions and cleanup must be handled in both directions. The 7-product low-basis completion estimate for J4 is only construction of missing low-address functions, not a complete new oracle cost.

accepted_loader_structure.special_case_reason: Initialization updates a nonlinear control inside the naive output-product window.

architecture_findings: For k=1..14 the exact shared high-address prelude has 68 CCX. Six additional prefix CCX complete the low-address feature set; total prefix 74. Cleanup uses HMR with conditioned CZ and zero additional CCX.

The output-product blocks have output linear mixing, so keeping only gates whose physical targets belong to chosen words does not preserve the projected outputs. Propagate output directions before pruning/projecting.
k=0 has initialization intertwined with nonlinear control updates; the existing simple output-window extractor cannot be used unmodified.

A prefix may be shared between subcomputations inside one file with cleanup at the end. It must be regenerated at the next file boundary. Different J also changes the required old-batch XOR new-batch transition functions.

The smaller J4 word bank releases eight physical qubits under the 128 cap. It increases family size from 15 to 19, so more prefix executions must be offset by product resynthesis and the lower persistent Q cost.
